free_tier.stated: Homepage: '上传下载永不限速，该权益开放给所有用户，无需开通会员即刻享有极速下载' + '签约领1024G — 为支持站长、自媒体主分享资源，小飞机网盘推出「开发者计划」活动，参与活动签约成功即可领取1TB网盘空间'. Baseline free space is small; the 1 TB comes from the developer-signing programme. Their own blog: '免费用户🉑️通过完成活动获取2T空间（非永久）'; VIP 10T / SVIP 15T.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: Unmetered and unshaped for everyone, including free: '下载不限速，百兆宽带，下载速度在75~80MB/S。无需开通会员即可享受不限速的下载。会员与非会员享同样的不限速'. Sharing links download without login.

tooling: Parsed by both qaiu/netdisk-fast-download (`fj`, 3.4k stars, returns a 302 direct link via /parser) and ByLsPro/JxPan (Cloudflare Worker). No OpenList driver, no WebDAV. So it is a *download* target rather than a mountable drive.
chaining: 1 TB per signed developer account; 2 TB per account via the activity path (time-limited). Accounts are email/phone based, so N accounts x 1 TB. Per-file 10 GB x unlimited files.
limits_note: Per-object-cap: 10 GB per file for free users ('单文件上传最大支持10G，会员目前最大也是不超过10G'). request-rate: upload throttling exists but is undocumented. The netdisk-fast-download README warns '小飞机近期封号频繁' and that parser use from datacenter IPs is blocked. Free batch upload capped at 30 files.

identity_cost.detail: any-phone (PRC number for the 2 TB activity; the 1 TB needs a signed developer agreement).

reliability_note: Actively bans: the most-used parser project warns of frequent account bans and IP-blocks for server-side use. 1 TB is conditional on a '签约' (signing) review, not signup.
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.
